propositions: The two-clone enrichment regression for bug 8185 requires git merge-tree --write-tree, available only in Git 2.38+, but the repository does not declare or enforce a Git version floor.
Runtime skip guards on capability-dependent tests create vacuous test rot by silently not executing on older clients, making the test appear covered when it is not.

Git 2.38+ must be declared as the supported floor, single-sourced in one canonical location, and enforced at pytest session initialization with a clear diagnostic that names the required and installed versions.
The enforcement must fail the entire pytest session before test collection rather than skip individual tests, preventing silent non-execution of the 8185 regression on unsupported clients.
Gating CI environments and contributor documentation must all reference the same declared Git floor to prevent drift and ensure the regression test executes on every CI lane.

The no-skip guarantee and regression presence must be verified by fail-closed guards that search the entire test tree rather than pinned paths, preventing silent vacuity from module renames or splits.
